sampling: Fixed first seed82001/start0, all4 rosters/both colors; first high-hand action, first high-hand refinement, first gift per policy/hero/initiating-action-class in protocol order; no favorable selection
limits: Actual interval losses are observed, not causal estimates of alternate actions
Gift recipient snapshots are evaluation-only actual state, never policy input
nextAction means next non-skipped own turn before its action, after begin-turn effects; same-turn extra actions remain in interval; ended games are censored
recipientAfter/donorAfter are immediate giveCards snapshots before later skill healing/overflow; use nextAction and events for the entire interval
Energy values are stock snapshots, not total gross expenditures; nested choices may spend between snapshots
High-hand samples start at action selection after begin-turn effects; aggregate telemetry counts at turn entry
